description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/epa/facility (base $0.01; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET with exactly one of state=VA, postal=20164 or registryId=110000339072, and optional limit=1-20.. EPA facility records from Envirofacts FRS for one state, postal code or registry id (up to 20): name, street address, city, county, state, postal code, coordinates and program flags. Source: U.S. EPA Envirofacts / FRS (public domain, 17 U.S.C. § 105). Not affiliated with or endorsed by the EPA. No match, bad input or source down: not charged. USDC on Base only.
